arm_a_state_identity.interpretation: Both are new bookkeeping keys carrying None for the arm with no memory. Entries, observations, population_state, credit, pool_continuity and all three RNG streams are identical, and arm A's proposal path reads neither key, so its next batch cannot differ.

arm_b_memory.problem: The 250-call run lived in one container, so arm B's memory was never serialised. A plain resume would restart it COLD -- a 1000-call memory experiment silently becoming a 250-call one followed by a reset.
arm_b_memory.resolution: restore() replays the archived counted observations through the same observation path the live run used
arm_b_memory.why_not: The live memory was never serialised, so byte-equality is unavailable. Only the audit ordinal stamped on donor rows depends on arrival order; every learned quantity is a sum or bounded max over the observations, so the replay reproduces the learned state.
